mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.2 million units signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1.2 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor demand, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS MoM > 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals robust consumer demand in a low unemployment environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand in low unemployment
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS YoY > 5% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases over three consecutive months.
